summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new auth (password policy, email verification, brute-force lockout, password reset) and subscription feature-gating (Starter locked; Growth unlocked). 26/26 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend register->verify-email flow, PasswordChecklist, sidebar lock indicators, and FeatureGate on direct navigation all work as specified. Admin/Starter/Growth logins all work.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking a locked sidebar item (nav-locked-utility-bills / nav-locked-maintenance / nav-locked-reports) navigates to /dashboard/billing (upgrade/plan page) rather than to the FeatureGate page at /dashboard/{feature}. This is a reasonable UX choice (jumps straight to upgrade), but review_request wording suggested clicking should show the FeatureGate screen. Direct navigation to /dashboard/bills, /dashboard/maintenance, /dashboard/reports, /dashboard/facility-managers correctly renders the corresponding feature-gate-* component.

issues: Recharts warnings: The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0 — chart container has 0 initial size (cosmetic console noise, chart still renders after resize).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide desired UX for locked nav click — if it should show FeatureGate page instead of Billing, change SidebarGroup locked-item handler to navigate to the feature path rather than /dashboard/billing.
OPTIONAL: Add min-height/min-width to Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrapper to silence width/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (4483 lines). Split into modules (auth, subscriptions, bills, maintenance, admin, tenants) for maintainability.
APP_ENV gates dev_verification_link/dev_link — good; ensure APP_ENV=production in prod deploys so tokens aren't leaked.
brute-force lockout resets `count` to 0 when locking; consecutive lockouts after unlock again require 5 more failures. Acceptable, but consider exponential backoff.
forgot-password always returns 200 for enumeration safety — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; one UX nit on locked-nav click destination)
